- Clears all transcripts, report, audio, and video data.
- Resets the interview status to PENDING.

post.description: Trigger the start of an interview. This mounts the AI agent into the LiveKit room.

Signal that the interview session is over and trigger background AI analysis.

This endpoint:
1. Validates the token and fetches the interview.
2. Ensures the interview is in a completable state.
3. Marks the interview as COMPLETED (if not already).
4. Schedules the AI transcript analysis as a background task.

The analysis runs asynchronously and will:
- Generate an individual performance report.
- Mark the interview as ANALYZED.
- Trigger synthesis if all 3 sibling interviews are ANALYZED.
Generate a time-bound LiveKit JWT to allow the participant to enter the WebRTC room.

Accept a client-side WebM recording (audio + video combined via MediaRecorder)
and persist it to storage/videos/.  Updates the interview's video_url.
